page.layout: One page of text, one column; heading centred at top; signature "ANIMAD." right-aligned below the text. No margin notes, no running head, no page number.

main_text.head: Lectori S.
main_text.p: cissem, omnino uon scripsis- sem. Rursus vero dico, me vehementer utrisque suam debere reverentiam, sed nec meam nec alterius fidem velim mancipari. Si quid profecerim in voto, mercedem habeo, sin minus, operam non totus perdidi, in magno conatu voluisse sat est. Tu interim qui has chartulas perlegeris, pro candore tuo, si quid erratum sit, ignosces. Vale.

page.notes: The first line of the page is a fragment continuing from the previous page ("cissem"). Some words are in long-s form and printed as "s"; rendered here as plain s. Final signature "ANIMAD." is set apart at the right and is a printed closing word, not a heading. Several words in the scan are blurred (e.g. "uon", "chartulas"), readings are provisional.
